label: Diagram 9
caption: Diagram 9 Protecting inner leaf (see paragraph 5.5(c))
description: The image is headed "Diagram 9 Protecting inner leaf (see paragraph 5.5(c))" and has two parts. Part (a), "Cavity carried down", shows two side-by-side sectional drawings of a cavity wall. Each is labelled "At least 225mm clear wall cavity depth" across the gap between the outer and inner leaves. A "Damp-proof course" is indicated by a hatched band in both leaves; both drawings note "dpc at least 150mm above ground level", measured from a "Ground level" line marked with a triangle. In the right drawing the inner leaf's damp-proof course sits higher, above a stippled block and a lattice mesh, with rubble below ground level, and the outer leaf's cavity edge is cut at a slope below ground. Part (b), "Damp proof (cavity) tray", is a section labelled "Outside" and "Inside". A tray, drawn as a thick black line, forms a channel with a "Weep hole"; a dimension reads "Minimum 150mm drop to tray", and the channel is captioned "Tray leading water to outside wall".
